import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,sys
p=Path.cwd()
for name in ['pairings','ordinarization','zerosum']:
 r=subprocess.run(['pdftotext','-layout',str(p/'sources'/f'{name}.pdf'),'-'],capture_output=True,text=True);assert r.returncode==0
 z=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(p/'write_lane.py'),f'sources/{name}.txt'],input=r.stdout,text=True,capture_output=True);assert z.returncode==0
 print('SOURCE',name,'LENGTH',len(r.stdout)); print(r.stdout[:10500])
